name: Martial Arts
description:
These benefits apply while you are unarmed or wielding only Monk weapons (Simple Melee weapons, and Martial Melee weapons with the Light property) and aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield:
Bonus Unarmed Strike: you can make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.
Martial Arts Die: you can roll a d6 in place of the normal damage of your Unarmed Strike or Monk weapon. The die becomes a d8 at level 5, a d10 at level 11, and a d12 at level 17.
Dexterous Attacks: you can use Dexterity in place of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons, and for the save DC of your Grapple and Shove options.

name: Unarmored Defense
description: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, your base Armor Class is 10 plus your Dexterity and Wisdom modifiers.

name: Monk's Focus
description:
You have a number of Focus Points equal to your Monk level, and you regain them all on a Short or Long Rest. When a feature of yours calls for a saving throw, the DC is 8 plus your Wisdom modifier and Proficiency Bonus. You start with three uses for them:
Flurry of Blows: spend 1 Focus Point to make two Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action.
Patient Defense: you can take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action. Or spend 1 Focus Point to take both the Disengage and Dodge actions as a Bonus Action.
Step of the Wind: you can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. Or spend 1 Focus Point to take both the Disengage and Dash actions as a Bonus Action, with your jump distance doubled for the turn.

name: Unarmored Movement
description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield. The bonus becomes 15 feet at level 6, 20 feet at level 10, 25 feet at level 14, and 30 feet at level 18.

name: Uncanny Metabolism
description: When you roll Initiative, you can regain all your spent Focus Points. When you do, roll your Martial Arts die and regain Hit Points equal to your Monk level plus the roll. You can do this once per Long Rest.

name: Deflect Attacks
description: When an attack roll hits you and deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, you can use your Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier and Monk level. If that brings the damage to 0, you can spend 1 Focus Point to redirect the attack at a creature within 5 feet of you (for a melee attack) or within 60 feet and not behind Total Cover (for a ranged attack). It must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take damage equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die plus your Dexterity modifier, of the same type as the attack.

name: Monk Subclass
description: You choose a subclass: Warrior of Mercy, Warrior of Shadow, Warrior of the Elements, or Warrior of the Open Hand. You gain its features at levels 3, 6, 11, and 17.

name: Ability Score Improvement
description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for. You gain this again at levels 8, 12, and 16.

name: Slow Fall
description: When you fall, you can use your Reaction to reduce the falling damage by five times your Monk level.

name: Extra Attack
description: You can attack twice, not once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

name: Stunning Strike
description: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a Monk weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can spend 1 Focus Point to attempt a stunning strike. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is Stunned until the start of your next turn. On a success, its Speed is halved until the start of your next turn and the next attack roll made against it before then has Advantage.

name: Empowered Strikes
description: Whenever you deal damage with an Unarmed Strike, it can deal Force damage or its normal damage type, as you choose.

name: Evasion
description: When you are subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw for half damage, you take no damage on a success and half on a failure. You can't use this while Incapacitated.

name: Acrobatic Movement
description: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, you can move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling during the movement.

name: Heightened Focus
description:
Your Focus options improve:
Flurry of Blows: spending the Focus Point gives you three Unarmed Strikes, not two.
Patient Defense: when you spend a Focus Point on it, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die.
Step of the Wind: when you spend a Focus Point on it, you can choose a willing Large or smaller creature within 5 feet and move it with you until the end of your turn. Its movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

name: Self-Restoration
description: At the end of each of your turns, you can remove one of these conditions from yourself: Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned. Also, going without food and drink doesn't give you levels of Exhaustion.

name: Deflect Energy
description: You can use Deflect Attacks against attacks that deal any damage type, not only Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing.

name: Disciplined Survivor
description: You gain proficiency in all saving throws. Also, whenever you fail a saving throw, you can spend 1 Focus Point to reroll it. You must use the new roll.

name: Perfect Focus
description: When you roll Initiative and don't use Uncanny Metabolism, you regain Focus Points until you have 4, if you have 3 or fewer.

name: Superior Defense
description: At the start of your turn, you can spend 3 Focus Points to gain Resistance to all damage except Force for 1 minute or until you are Incapacitated.

name: Epic Boon
description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for. Boon of Irresistible Offense is the suggested choice.

name: Body and Mind
description: Your Dexterity and Wisdom scores each increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.

name: Hand of Harm
description: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can spend 1 Focus Point to deal extra Necrotic damage equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die plus your Wisdom modifier.

name: Hand of Healing
description: As a Magic action, you can spend 1 Focus Point and touch a creature to restore Hit Points equal to a roll of your Martial Arts die plus your Wisdom modifier. When you use Flurry of Blows, you can replace one of its Unarmed Strikes with a use of this feature without spending a Focus Point for the healing.

name: Implements of Mercy
description: You gain proficiency in the Insight and Medicine skills and with the Herbalism Kit.

name: Physician's Touch
description:
Hand of Harm: you can also give the target the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn.
Hand of Healing: you can also end one of these conditions on the creature you heal: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned.

name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
description: When you use Flurry of Blows, you can replace each of its Unarmed Strikes with a use of Hand of Healing without spending Focus Points for the healing. Also, when you deal damage with an Unarmed Strike from Flurry of Blows, you can use Hand of Harm with it without spending a Focus Point, still only once per turn. You can use these benefits a total number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), regaining them on a Long Rest.

name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
description: As a Magic action, you can touch the corpse of a creature that died within the past 24 hours and spend 5 Focus Points. It returns to life with Hit Points equal to 4d10 plus your Wisdom modifier. If it died with any of the Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned conditions, they are removed. You can do this once per Long Rest.

name: Shadow Arts
description:
Darkness: you can spend 1 Focus Point to cast Darkness without spell components. You can see within the spell's area, and while it lasts you can move the area up to 60 feet at the start of each of your turns.
Darkvision: you gain Darkvision out to 60 feet, or 60 more feet if you already have it.
Shadowy Figments: you know the Minor Illusion cantrip, with Wisdom as your spellcasting ability for it.

name: Shadow Step
description: While you are entirely in Dim Light or Darkness, you can use a Bonus Action to teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in Dim Light or Darkness. You then have Advantage on the next melee attack you make before the end of the turn.

name: Improved Shadow Step
description: When you use Shadow Step, you can spend 1 Focus Point to ignore the requirement to start and end in Dim Light or Darkness. As part of the same Bonus Action, you can make an Unarmed Strike right after you teleport.

name: Cloak of Shadows
description:
As a Magic action while you are entirely in Dim Light or Darkness, you can spend 3 Focus Points to wrap yourself in shadow for 1 minute, until you are Incapacitated, or until you end your turn in Bright Light. While it lasts:
Invisibility: you have the Invisible condition.
Partially Incorporeal: you can move through occupied spaces as if they were Difficult Terrain. If you end your turn in one, you are moved to the last unoccupied space you were in.
Shadow Flurry: you can use Flurry of Blows without spending Focus Points.

name: Elemental Attunement
description:
At the start of your turn, you can spend 1 Focus Point to fill yourself with elemental energy for 10 minutes or until you are Incapacitated. While it lasts:
Reach: your reach is 10 feet longer when you make an Unarmed Strike.
Elemental Strikes: your Unarmed Strike can deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage in place of its normal type. When it does, you can make the target attempt a Strength saving throw; on a failure, you move it up to 10 feet toward or away from you.

name: Manipulate Elements
description: You know the Elementalism cantrip, with Wisdom as your spellcasting ability for it.

name: Elemental Burst
description: As a Magic action, you can spend 2 Focus Points to make elemental energy burst in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within 120 feet. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. Each creature in the Sphere makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking damage of that type equal to three rolls of your Martial Arts die on a failure, or half on a success.

name: Stride of the Elements
description: While your Elemental Attunement is active, you have a Fly Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

name: Elemental Epitome
description:
While your Elemental Attunement is active:
Damage Resistance: you have Resistance to one of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage, and can change the choice at the start of each of your turns.
Destructive Stride: when you use Step of the Wind, your Speed increases by 20 feet until the end of the turn. During that time, a creature you pass within 5 feet of takes damage equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die, of your choice of those five types. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.
Empowered Strikes: once on each of your turns, you can deal extra damage to a target you hit with an Unarmed Strike, equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die and of the same type as the strike.

name: Open Hand Technique
description:
Whenever you hit a creature with an attack granted by Flurry of Blows, you can impose one effect:
Addle: the target can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.
Push: the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from you.
Topple: the target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be knocked Prone.

name: Wholeness of Body
description: As a Bonus Action, you roll your Martial Arts die and regain Hit Points equal to the roll plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1 Hit Point). You have a number of uses equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) and regain them on a Long Rest.

name: Fleet Step
description: When you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind, you can also use Step of the Wind right after it.

name: Quivering Palm
description: When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you can spend 4 Focus Points to start harmless vibrations in its body that last for a number of days equal to your Monk level. You can have only one creature affected at a time. When you take the Attack action, you can give up one of the attacks to end the vibrations, as long as you and the target are on the same plane of existence. The target then makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d12 Force damage on a failure or half on a success. You can also end them harmlessly (no action required).
